evidence.detail: warnings.filterwarnings('error', category=MySQLdb.Warning) — converts all MySQL server warnings into Python MySQLdb.Warning exceptions on every query

execute_anything catches MySQLdb.Warning; only suppresses codes 1050 (table already exists), 1051 (unknown table), 1062 (duplicate insert); all other warnings including 1264 (out of range value) fall through to raise DatabaseException
Remove last vestiges of the mysql/sqlite split — introduced the current shared/database.py with filterwarnings('error') in 2018

triage.notes: Confidence is medium rather than high because we cannot run a live test to confirm warning 1264 propagates as MySQLdb.Warning in the deployed MySQLdb version; if it does not (e.g., warnings are fetched differently in newer MySQLdb), the issue would revert to open. Worth a quick manual test before closing.
triage.proposed_comment: The database layer already converts MySQL warnings to errors: `warnings.filterwarnings('error', category=MySQLdb.Warning)` at `shared/database.py:15` makes MySQLdb raise on any MySQL warning, and `execute_anything` (lines 54–59) only suppresses codes 1050, 1051, and 1062 — overflow warning 1264 is not suppressed and would surface as a `DatabaseException`. This was put in place in commit 679ec1d9.
